pairs.gold_text: Community support was organized in Brayle during community recovery.
pairs.system_text: Community support was organized in Brayle.

pairs.gold_text: No deaths were reported in connection with Kellet Point fire.
pairs.system_text: No deaths were reported in connection with the Kellet Point fire.

pairs.gold_text: Injuries were reported during the Kellet Point fire.
pairs.system_text: Injuries were documented and subsequently confirmed in Osmery.

pairs.gold_text: Damage was reported in Brayle during the Kellet Point fire.

unmatched_gold.text: Reports stated that the Fallon Coatings warehouse was not involved in the reported damage.

pairs.gold_text: Service was restored in Brayle during the Kellet Point fire.
Kellet Road was closed in Kellet Point industrial estate and Merrin Canal.
pairs.system_text: Kellet Road was closed in the Kellet Point industrial estate and at Merrin Canal.

pairs.gold_text: Services were closed in Brayle during the Kellet Point fire.
pairs.system_text: Services were closed in Brayle at the end of the reporting window.

pairs.gold_text: Service was disrupted in Kellet Point industrial estate during the Kellet Point fire.
pairs.system_text: Service was disrupted in the Kellet Point industrial estate.

pairs.gold_text: About 300 people were displaced from Osmery during evacuation and displacement operations.
pairs.system_text: About 300 people were displaced from Osmery.

unmatched_system.text: About 2,300 residents were evacuated from Brayle under the mandatory order.
A later official figure gave 48 residents evacuated from Brayle, alongside evacuations from Osmery.

pairs.gold_text: A mandatory evacuation moved about 2,300 residents from Brayle during evacuation and displacement operations.
pairs.system_text: A mandatory evacuation was ordered for Brayle.

pairs.gold_text: Sunder Flats was never subject to an evacuation during evacuation and displacement operations.
pairs.system_text: Sunder Flats was never subject to an evacuation order.

unmatched_gold.text: 48 residents were evacuated from Brayle, and people were evacuated from Osmery.

pairs.gold_text: No contamination was recorded in Merrin Canal during the Kellet Point fire.
pairs.system_text: No contamination was recorded in Merrin Canal.

unmatched_system.text: The Fallon Coatings warehouse was reported not to have been involved in the fire.

unmatched_gold.text: Assistance was received in Brayle as response operations continued.

pairs.gold_text: Provincial Environmental Protection Agency deployed as response operations continued.
pairs.system_text: The Provincial Environmental Protection Agency deployed on the second day.

unmatched_system.text: Fallon Coatings, the site operator, deployed to the incident.

pairs.gold_text: Information was provided about Kellet Road during emergency communications.
pairs.system_text: Information was provided about the Kellet Road closure.

pairs.gold_text: OES provided information during emergency communications.
pairs.system_text: OES provided information at the end of the reporting window.

unmatched_gold.text: It is possible that Provincial Environmental Protection Agency provided information during emergency communications.

pairs.gold_text: Assistance was requested in Kellet Point industrial estate during emergency communications.
pairs.system_text: Assistance was requested in the Kellet Point industrial estate.

pairs.gold_text: A warning was issued for Brayle and Sunder Flats during emergency communications.
pairs.system_text: A warning was issued for Brayle and Sunder Flats.

unmatched_system.text: A further warning was issued for Sunder Flats.
A warning was issued for Merrin Canal on the second day.
A transfer was completed in Brayle.
